# gws recipe: Create a Classroom course

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the create-classroom-course recipe: create a Google Classroom course and invite students in 3 commands — create the course, invite a student, list the enrolled students. A recipe, not a reference: it complements `googleworkspace-cli-gws-classroom` (the raw Classroom API reference, this lot) the same way lot 31 recipes complement their APIs — the concrete end-to-end flow vs the API docs.
